name: Soktas Tekstil Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Söktas Tekstil Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S., through its subsidiaries, engages in the textile and dairy businesses. It produces and sells fabrics. The company is also involved in the agricultural-dairy livestock activities, as well as dairy cow cultivation, milk production, and sale of raw milk. Söktas Tekstil Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Aydin, Turkey.
